title: Ted Lasso Season 4 Premieres on Apple TV
text:
The new season of Ted Lasso follows Ted as he coaches a second division women's football team in Richmond, with a possible three-season arc if Season 5 moves forward.
Ted Lasso Season 4 has premiered on Apple TV, following the story of Ted as he coaches a second division women's football team in Richmond.
Jason Sudeikis returns alongside Hannah Waddingham, Juno Temple, Brett Goldstein, Brendan Hunt and Jeremy Swift. New cast members include Tanya Reynolds, Jude Mack, Faye Marsay and Rex Hayes among others. If Season 5 moves forward, it will likely continue following the women's team as part of a possible three-season arc. Cherniss expressed strong confidence in Apple TV's comedy lineup going forward, stating that the platform has the best comedy brand in the business.
He also mentioned that moving from Shrinking and Widow's Bay to Ted Lasso and The Studio next year puts Apple TV in a strong position. Cherniss revealed that Jason Sudeikis already has plans to begin work on the next installment of Ted Lasso, but Apple TV has not yet officially renewed the show for a fifth season.
Sudeikis also serves as showrunner, head writer and executive producer on the comedy series, which earned 61 Emmy nominations across its first three seasons on the streaming platform
